descriptionChirho: Proper noun referring to the ancient Phoenician coastal city of Sidon (modern Saida, Lebanon), also the firstborn son of Canaan after whom the city was named. All four clusters represent the same referent with variation only in prepositional framing and transliteration style. Multilingual glosses confirm identity: Spanish Sidón/Tsidón, Arabic صَيْدَا/صَيْدُونَ (both Sidon), Korean 시돈 (Sidon), Hindi सीदोन (Sidon), Swahili Sidoni. Differences are purely syntactic (to, from, of Sidon).
